title: Grafana Alert Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=grafana:alert
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by alertname
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>1
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Grafana alert data has stopped arriving for a given alert.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per alert and alert when the feed is older than 1 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It catches when one part of your Grafana alert feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
